Repo half of the rollback rehearsal incl. R-1 (revoked or unreadable svc-killswitch key under REQUIRE: every kill and revive answers 502 fail closed; B-7 break-glass with don-breakglass is the only path). First grep the kill-switch and field-core tests for an existing test of exactly this and cite it; add only what is missing. Required tests (real kill-switch and registry TestClient apps, REQUIRE set inside the tests only): (1) svc-killswitch key revoked in the operators file: kill and revive 502, no state change, health reports the refusal, (2) key file unreadable: same, (3) the same kill with don-breakglass headers succeeds and the ledger row names don-breakglass, (4) after the key is restored kills pass again, (5) OFF and LOG-ONLY unchanged. Mutants: 502 becomes 200 (fail open), break-glass not honoured, no ledger attribution. Then add to docs/runbooks/v1.2-deploy-rollback.md Stage 2 rollback a numbered rehearsal script for the deployer (steps and expected output only, no estate values). Done when: tests green with mutants dead, runbook text added, CI green, GX10 on the exact head. Deployer-only: running the rehearsal on the estate.

Deployer Stage 3 condition S3-1 (comms/inbox/estate-deployer/20261106-2000-stage2-plan-go-sentence.md), plan in comms/inbox/architect/20261107-0900-architect-stage2-stage3-e-runbook-cards.md: Stage 3 needs a clean judged Stage 2 window, and the tool judges only Stage 1. Stacks on PR 837 after its conditions card (B-PR837-g18-decrease-span) merges; do not start before that. Add a stage 2 mode to the window evaluation: services judged are kill-switch and registry only; kill-switch operator_mode must read enforce in both snapshots, registry log-only in both (a flip is not clean); dropped_unauthenticated and refused counters must not rise or decrease; operator_internal_route_denied must not rise; same span and minimum-hours rules as G18; writes one gate row S2WINDOW bound to sha8 on a clean window only, fails closed on any missing field. Done when: tests per fail-closed path, mutants (mode flip accepted, registry judged as enforce, decrease accepted, deny counter ignored, row written on failure) die, CI green, GX10 on the exact head. Deployer-only: taking the snapshots on the estate and deciding the window length (Don).

The deployer reports five: the other three are not reproduced from the repo, probably estate-installed untracked ssl-fp-* manifests, which are deployer work. Add don-admin to those two lists, and a test that walks manifests/*.yaml and fails for any non-empty list without don-admin. Check first whether a manifest hash or manifest_ref is pinned anywhere that the edit changes (tools, registry fixtures, runbook) and update the pin in the same PR; say in the PR that the estate needs the changed manifest_ref registered by don-admin (G21 rule). Done when: test and mutant (don-admin removed from one list) green and dead, CI green, GX10 on the exact head, no estate touched.
